blockers.detail: The runner reads baseline_output_receipt.path to derive the expected output-name set, but does not verify that file against baseline_output_receipt.sha256 before parsing it. The plan carries the digest, but the runner never checks it; root-source-preflight-v5 does not bind this separate baseline output receipt. Thus the postflight output-name inventory can use a modified receipt despite the pinned digest.
blockers.impact: Integrity gap in postflight output inventory only; this does not alter solver inputs or numerical acceptance, but the inventory is not authenticated as planned.

disposition: Do not treat this v5 runner as fully reviewed for execution until the baseline receipt is digest-checked before JSON parsing, or the same receipt is explicitly authenticated by another prelaunch gate.
review_scope: Exact frozen v5 plan/runner and root source-preflight artifacts; no build, solver, model, or raw-output execution.
verified: v5 runner and plan pins match their declared frozen SHA-256 values.
Root source preflight verifies 446 staged regular files and 16 symlink texts; only src/oprop.f90 is the intended source overlay.
Build gate binds stage receipts, source, Makefiles, donor executable and complete object roster; it requires a terminal RC0 and only the oprop object/executable to change before solver eligibility.

Solver gate requires the completed incremental-build receipt, checks executable and staged case/input identities, durably records child PID/return code before inspecting outputs, rejects timeout as success, and checks post-run input immutability.
Launch/retry guards and bounded terminate/kill/reap cleanup cover the previously identified repeat-launch and child-cleanup paths.
